
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/hont/p/19109354" title="发布于 2025-09-24 15:49">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">聊聊前序、中序、后序表达式</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">在游戏开发中，我们经常需要在配置表中定义各种公式，比如&nbsp;<code>a * (b + c)</code>，用来计算技能伤害、属性加成等。如果直接让程序在运行时解析并执行这些公式，就需要处理运算符优先级和括号等复杂问题。</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">这时，后序表达式就派上了用场。我们将中序表达式&nbsp;<code>a * (b + c)</code>&nbsp;转换为后序表达式&nbsp;<code>a b c + *</code>，这样程序只需要一个栈就能高效计算，无需担心优先级和括号。</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">而要深入理解后序表达式，就不得不提到与之相关的完整概念体系：前序表达式、中序表达式和后序表达式。这三种表达式各有特点，共同构成了计算机处理数学表达式的理论基础。</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">&nbsp;</p>
<h1 class="ds-markdown-paragraph">1.中序(中缀)&amp;前序表达式</h1>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">中序表达式就是日常书写的公式，但这种日常公式对计算机并不友好，有括号、优先级等需要考虑，计算机直接读取较为麻烦</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">因此波兰数学家扬·武卡谢维奇发明了"波兰表示法"（前序表达式）</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">所以前序表达式又叫做 波兰式</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">例如LISP的语法风格就是基于前序表达式的：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>;; 中序: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span> + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span> * <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
;; 前序: 
</span>+ <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span> * <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>    ; =&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">7</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

;; 中序: (</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span> + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>) * <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  
;; 前序:
</span>* + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>   ; =&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">9</span></pre>
</div>
<p>而我们现在使用较多的则是后序表达式，因为中序表达式转换为后序表达式内存开销较少，计算更为友好。</p>
<h1>2.后序表达式(逆波兰式)</h1>
<p>几个逆波兰式的例子：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>中序：<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span> + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
后序：</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span> +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

中序：</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span> + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span> * <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
后序：</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span> * +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

中序：(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span> + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>) * <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
后序：</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span> + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span> *</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>通常可以将表达式从中序转逆序后存放在内存里，供计算时使用。也可以通过双栈法直接计算出结果。</p>
<p>常见的中序转逆序算法如下。</p>
<h2>2.1 中序转后序表达式</h2>
<p>示例公式：(A + B) * C</p>
<p>首先创建栈结构存放符号</p>
<p>从左向右读取原公式，读到非符号输出，读到符号以如下规则操作：</p>
<ul>
<li>若栈为空，读到符号可以直接入栈</li>
<li>* / 优先级高于 + -，将读取到的符号与栈顶符号做比较，若&lt;=栈顶符号，则出栈(循环操作，直到条件不满足)，并输出</li>
<li>若读取到左括号(，则连同括号一起入栈。若读取到右括号)，则循环出栈，直到找到左括号位置</li>
<li>若所有内容读取完，则输出栈的内容</li>
</ul>
<p>注：输出是指将值添加至返回值字符串或其他数据格式</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>参照上面写的示例公式，操作流程如下：</p>
<ol data-start="942" data-end="1210">
<li data-start="942" data-end="976">
<p data-start="945" data-end="976">读 <code data-start="947" data-end="950">(</code>&nbsp; 入栈<br data-start="955" data-end="958">
栈：<code data-start="963" data-end="966">(</code><br data-start="966" data-end="969">
输出：空</p>





</li>
<li data-start="978" data-end="1003">
<p data-start="981" data-end="1003">读 <code data-start="983" data-end="986">A</code>&nbsp; 输出<br data-start="991" data-end="994">
输出：<code data-start="1000" data-end="1003">A</code></p>





</li>
<li data-start="1005" data-end="1044">
<p data-start="1008" data-end="1044">读 <code data-start="1010" data-end="1013">+</code>&nbsp; 入栈<br data-start="1018" data-end="1021">
栈：<code data-start="1026" data-end="1032">(, +</code><br data-start="1032" data-end="1035">
输出：<code data-start="1041" data-end="1044">A</code></p>





</li>
<li data-start="1046" data-end="1073">
<p data-start="1049" data-end="1073">读 <code data-start="1051" data-end="1054">B</code>&nbsp;输出<br data-start="1059" data-end="1062">
输出：<code data-start="1068" data-end="1073">A B</code></p>





</li>
<li data-start="1075" data-end="1130">
<p data-start="1078" data-end="1130">读 <code data-start="1080" data-end="1083">)</code>&nbsp;弹出直到遇到 <code data-start="1093" data-end="1096">(</code> → 弹出 <code data-start="1102" data-end="1105">+</code><br data-start="1105" data-end="1108">
栈：空<br data-start="1114" data-end="1117">
输出：<code data-start="1123" data-end="1130">A B +</code></p>





</li>
<li data-start="1132" data-end="1177">
<p data-start="1135" data-end="1177">读 <code data-start="1137" data-end="1140">*</code>&nbsp;栈空 ， 入栈<br data-start="1150" data-end="1153">
栈：<code data-start="1158" data-end="1161">*</code><br data-start="1161" data-end="1164">
输出：<code data-start="1170" data-end="1177">A B +</code></p>





</li>
<li data-start="1179" data-end="1210">
<p data-start="1182" data-end="1210">读 <code data-start="1184" data-end="1187">C</code>&nbsp;输出<br data-start="1192" data-end="1195">
输出：<code data-start="1201" data-end="1210">A B + C</code></p>





</li>





</ol>
<p data-start="1212" data-end="1232">结束后弹栈：输出 <code data-start="1221" data-end="1232">A B + C *</code></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>通常游戏配表中的公式可运用到此方法，以带变量公式为例，进行代码演示</p>
<p>1 + 2 * 3 + (4 * e + f) * g</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>代码如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>ConvertRpn(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">1 + 2 * 3 + (4 * e + f) * g</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> rpnStr);
Debug.Log(rpnStr);</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">1 2 3 * + 4 e * f + g * +</span></pre>
</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> ConvertRpn(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> inStr, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> rpnStr)
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> GetPriority(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ch)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> ch <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">switch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">+</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> or <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">-</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> =&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">*</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> or <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> =&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> =&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>,    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 左括号在栈内优先级最低</span>
            _ =&gt; -<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>      <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 其他情况（包括右括号）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        };
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> rpnBuilder = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> StringBuilder();
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> stack = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Stack&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> numBuilder = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> StringBuilder();

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> ch <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> inStr)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (Char.IsWhiteSpace(ch))
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 遇到空格时，如果正在构建数字，就完成这个数字</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (numBuilder.Length &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            {
                rpnBuilder.Append(numBuilder.ToString()).Append(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                numBuilder.Clear();
            }
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">continue</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span>.IsDigit(ch) || ch == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 数字或小数点：添加到数字构建器</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            numBuilder.Append(ch);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">continue</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 遇到操作符前，先完成当前数字的构建</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (numBuilder.Length &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            {
                rpnBuilder.Append(numBuilder.ToString()).Append(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                numBuilder.Clear();
            }
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">switch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (ch)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
                stack.Push(ch);
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 弹出直到遇到左括号</span>
                <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span> (stack.Count &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> &amp;&amp; stack.Peek() != <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                {
                    rpnBuilder.Append(stack.Pop()).Append(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                }
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (stack.Count &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> &amp;&amp; stack.Peek() == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                {
                    stack.Pop(); </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 弹出左括号但不输出</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                }
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">+</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">-</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">*</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 处理操作符优先级</span>
                <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span> (stack.Count &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> &amp;&amp; stack.Peek() != <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> &amp;&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                        GetPriority(ch) </span>&lt;=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> GetPriority(stack.Peek()))
                {
                    rpnBuilder.Append(stack.Pop()).Append(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                }
                stack.Push(ch);
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
                rpnBuilder.Append(ch).Append(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        }
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 处理最后一个数字（如果存在）</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (numBuilder.Length &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    {
        rpnBuilder.Append(numBuilder.ToString()).Append(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 弹出栈中剩余操作符</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span> (stack.Count &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    {
        rpnBuilder.Append(stack.Pop()).Append(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 移除末尾多余的空格</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (rpnBuilder.Length &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> &amp;&amp; rpnBuilder[rpnBuilder.Length - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>] == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    {
        rpnBuilder.Length</span>--<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    }

    rpnStr </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> rpnBuilder.ToString();
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;这样就可以将公式转换为后序表达式先存放在内存中了。</p>
<h2>2.2 求解后序表达式</h2>
<p>求解后续表达式，同样需要一个栈结构来辅助。</p>
<p data-start="130" data-end="134">规则是：</p>
<ol data-start="135" data-end="272"><ol data-start="135" data-end="272">
<li data-start="135" data-end="163">
<p data-start="138" data-end="163"><strong data-start="138" data-end="154">遇到操作数（数字/变量）</strong> → 压入栈。</p>
</li>
<li data-start="164" data-end="254">
<p data-start="167" data-end="192"><strong data-start="167" data-end="176">遇到运算符</strong> → 从栈中弹出两个操作数：</p>
<ul data-start="196" data-end="254">
<li data-start="196" data-end="213">
<p data-start="198" data-end="213"><strong data-start="198" data-end="211">先弹出的是右操作数</strong></p>
</li>
<li data-start="217" data-end="254">
<p data-start="219" data-end="254"><strong data-start="219" data-end="232">再弹出的是左操作数</strong><br data-start="232" data-end="235">
然后进行运算，把结果压回栈。</p>





</li>





</ul>





</li>
<li data-start="255" data-end="272">
<p data-start="258" data-end="272">扫描完后，栈顶就是最终结果</p>




</li>




</ol></ol>
<p>代码如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>rpnStr = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">1 2 3 * + 4 e * f + g * +</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = CalcPrn(rpnStr, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Dictionary&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">float</span>&gt; { [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">e</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>] = 10f, [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">f</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>] = 12f, [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">g</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>] =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 14f });
Debug.Log(result);</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 735</span></pre>
</div>

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">float</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)stack.Pop();

<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2>2.3 双栈法直接求值</h2>
<p>使用双栈法，可以不用转换为后序表达式再求值，而是直接求值。</p>
<p>核心思想是使用2个栈，数值栈和字符栈。当字符栈弹出时，顺便就计算当前步骤结果并且放回数值栈。</p>
<p>代码如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = CalcPrnDoubleStack(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">1 + 2 * 3 + (4 * e + f) * g</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Dictionary&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">float</span>&gt; { [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">e</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>] = 10f, [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">f</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>] = 12f, [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">g</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>] =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 14f });
Debug.Log(result);</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 735</span></pre>
</div>

<pre> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">float</span> CalcPrnDoubleStack(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> inStr, Dictionary&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">float</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> replace)
 {
     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> GetPriority(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ch)
     {
         </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> ch <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">switch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
         {
             </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">+</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> or <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">-</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> =&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
             </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">*</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> or <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> =&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,

             _ =&gt; -<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>      <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 其他情况（包括右括号）</span>

     }

     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">float</span> Calc(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">float</span> x, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">float</span> y, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> token)
     {
         </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> token <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">switch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
         {
             </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">+</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> =&gt; x +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> y,
             </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">-</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> =&gt; x -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> y,
             </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">*</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> =&gt; x *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> y,
             </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> =&gt; x /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> y,

     }
     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> stackNum = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Stack&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">float</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> stackToken = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Stack&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();

     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> numBuilder = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> StringBuilder();

     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> ch <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> inStr)
     {
         </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (Char.IsWhiteSpace(ch))
         {
             </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 遇到空格时，如果正在构建数字，就完成这个数字</span>
             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (numBuilder.Length &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
             {
                 stackNum.Push(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">float</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.Parse(numBuilder.ToString()));
                 numBuilder.Clear();
             }
             </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">continue</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
         }

         </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">char</span>.IsDigit(ch) || ch == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
         {
             </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 数字或小数点：添加到数字构建器</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">             numBuilder.Append(ch);
             </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">continue</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
         }
         </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
         {
             </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 遇到操作符前，先完成当前数字的构建</span>
             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (numBuilder.Length &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
             {
                 stackNum.Push(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">float</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.Parse(numBuilder.ToString()));
                 numBuilder.Clear();
             }
         }

         </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">switch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (ch)
         {
             </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
                 stackToken.Push(ch);
                 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

             </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
                 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span> (stackToken.Count &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> &amp;&amp; stackToken.Peek() != <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                 {
                     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> token =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> stackToken.Pop();
                     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> y =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> stackNum.Pop();
                     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> x =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> stackNum.Pop();
                     stackNum.Push(Calc(x, y, token));
                 }
                 stackToken.Pop();
                 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

             </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">+</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
             </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">-</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
             </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">*</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
             </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
                 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span> (stackToken.Count &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> &amp;&amp; stackToken.Peek() != <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> &amp;&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                     GetPriority(ch) </span>&lt;=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> GetPriority(stackToken.Peek()))
                 {
                     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> token =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> stackToken.Pop();
                     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> y =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> stackNum.Pop();
                     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> x =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> stackNum.Pop();
                     stackNum.Push(Calc(x, y, token));
                 }
                 stackToken.Push(ch);
                 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

             </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:

                 stackNum.Push(replace[ch]);

                 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
         }
     }

     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span> (stackToken.Count &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
     {
         </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> token =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> stackToken.Pop();
         </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> y =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> stackNum.Pop();
         </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> x =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> stackNum.Pop();
         stackNum.Push(Calc(x, y, token));
     }

     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> stackNum.Pop();
 }</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
